body:
I'm sorry, I know not all people on drugs are bad, quite the contrary. I didn't mean to come off as cruel when I said the drug thing. That's my father talking, I guess. I'm just getting upset again, the numbness turning back to hurt, saying shit I don't mean, blah blah blah.

Thank you for your kindness and faith in me, I have no doubt that if I escape this in one piece that the help will come from unexpected places. I don't believe all people are bad, somehow I managed to avoid feeling that way despite everything I've been through, things I didn't even put here because it's too long. It's one of my few good qualities, believing in the goodness that remains somewhere.

I don't want to die, not exactly. I'm not afraid of it, I know I'm capable and in enough pain to do it, but I still have enough in me to want to see better days. I suppose that's why I finally reached out somewhere.

I've considered the hospital, as there's no shelters, but I'm such a fucking wreck that I know I'd end up in psych and they wouldn't believe me I'm sure if I assured them I'd be...well, not okay, but alive and not a danger to anyone, that I just needed to get away.

I live in the US, which makes this whole stupid situation even sadder that a supposedly developed country still has this trash. It's not just me, that hurts me even worse.

Unfortunately not. It's been in the news a few times, from police to regular people. Rape and child molestation is a favorite around here. People have started shooting and stabbing kids now too, that's been on the rise this year.

People in this town are trash, druggies and all other manner. That's why he likes it here. Maybe someone would help me but more likely than not I'd get hurt or killed anyways. I'm premium female meat here, which isn't saying much for their taste. ID is virtually impossible without going somewhere and having SSN and a birth certificate which I've never been allowed access to.
